facts.fact: Wavemaker videos are typically finished in two to five minutes, according to the vendor's own page.
facts.quote: Most videos are done in two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave's page advertises streaming TV promo runs starting from $30 a day.
facts.quote: Streaming TV, from $30 a day via Adwave

facts.fact: Adwave's page also states that streaming TV commercials start from $50, which conflicts with the $30-a-day figure on the same page.
facts.quote: Adwave can run it as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, from $50, with local targeting

facts.fact: Adwave's page says its streaming TV ads can run on more than 100 premium networks.
Wavemaker's menu-highlights input is described as 4 to 8 photos of signature dishes, or a menu URL.
facts.quote: 4-8 photos of signature dishes, or your menu URL

facts.fact: Wavemaker exports video in 9:16 vertical format for Instagram and TikTok.
facts.quote: Wavemaker exports in 9:16 vertical for these platforms

facts.fact: The vendor recommends restaurant promo videos of about fifteen to thirty seconds for social and streaming TV.
facts.quote: Fifteen to thirty seconds is the sweet spot for social and for a streaming TV spot.

facts.fact: The vendor advises leading a food video with the most appealing shot in the first two seconds.
facts.quote: Lead with your single most crave-worthy shot in the first two seconds.

facts.fact: Custom AI voiceover design is available only on paid Wavemaker plans.
facts.quote: you can design a custom voice on paid plans

facts.fact: The page was published on July 20, 2026.
Adwave can run a Wavemaker restaurant video as a streaming TV spot with local targeting starting at $30 a day, according to the page's four-week plan.
facts.quote: run it as a streaming TV spot via Adwave with local targeting, from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave can run a finished Wavemaker video as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, starting at $50.
facts.quote: Adwave can run it as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, starting at $50, with local targeting

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the page says is enough for a first video at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: You can start free with 75 credits, which is enough for your first video (480p with a watermark).

facts.fact: Wavemaker paid plans begin at $29 a month for 500 credits, with up to 1080p output and no watermark.
facts.quote: Paid plans begin at $29 a month for 500 credits, up to 1080p, and no watermark

facts.fact: Wavemaker credit packs never expire, according to the page.
facts.quote: Credit packs never expire, so occasional videos don't force a subscription.

facts.fact: According to the page, most Wavemaker videos generate in two to five minutes after input is provided.
facts.quote: Most videos generate in two to five minutes after you provide your input.

facts.fact: The page states that Wavemaker supports vertical 9:16 export for Reels, TikTok, and Stories, and 16:9 widescreen for websites, Google Business Profile, or TV spots.
facts.quote: Export vertical 9:16 for Reels, TikTok, and Stories so the video fills the screen. For your website, Google Business Profile, or a TV spot, 16:9 widescreen works best.

facts.fact: The page says a restaurant can make a Wavemaker video without professional photos by pasting a website or menu URL so the tool pulls existing imagery and branding.
facts.quote: you can also skip photos entirely by pasting your website or menu URL so Wavemaker pulls your existing imagery and branding.
